summary: Tested the new ONE-command VPS installer (wa-setup.sh), deploy.sh auto-call integration, backend regression (26 WA/bounce tests), and the updated WhatsApp health banner content (down + hidden states). All checks pass.
critical_code_review_comments: wa-setup.sh: well-structured, idempotent, uses APP_DIR auto-detect via BASH_SOURCE, reuses existing WA_SERVICE_SECRET if present, ensures WA_SERVICE_URL is set, writes correct supervisor config with absolute node bin path, runs yarn install (frozen-lockfile fallback), reread+update+restart, then restarts backend, then health-checks via curl http://localhost:3002/health. bash -n syntax check passes.

deploy.sh: contains the auto-install branch ('WA Service belum di supervisor — auto-setup sekarang') which calls 'sudo bash wa-setup.sh' when supervisor program $SUPERVISOR_WA does not exist. Note (non-blocking): the fallback branch uses 'warn' helper which is not defined in deploy.sh (only log/ok/err exist). Will crash with 'warn: command not found' under set -u IF wa-setup.sh is genuinely missing on the server. Low risk since the file ships in the repo, but worth defining warn() for safety.

WhatsApp.jsx banner: content matches all 6 required strings (SSH header, full cd && sudo bash wa-setup.sh command, 'Script otomatis: generate secret…', 'Idempotent', deploy alias, curl verify). Terminal-look (slate-900 + emerald-300) renders correctly. Banner correctly hidden when WA Service is RUNNING (verified by toggling supervisorctl).
context_for_next_testing_agent: wa-service was stopped and restarted during this run; final state RUNNING (pid checked, /health returns {"ok":true}). Pytest produced 26/26 PASSED in 14.15s. Banner expand-via-<details><summary> works; selector data-testid='wa-health-banner'. App URL: https://contabo-server-setup.preview.emergentagent.com.
